messages:
PagerBot: :pager: SEV1 - large spike in 5xx for inference.redwood.app across eu-central-1 and eu-west-1 observed 2025-11-05T14:12:01Z. Auto-failover triggered to ap-south-1. Paging @sree_oncall.

Sree (oncall): ack. I'm seeing health-checks flipflopping on the eu edges at ~14:11. Locking channel for noise.

Ami - NetEng: grabbing BGP MRTs and edge logs. Preliminary: edge LB health-checks are getting inconsistent responses from our regional probes. I see a stream of SYN-RSTs from a small set of edge IPs in eu-west.

Liam - SRE: backend clusters are reporting normal pod counts. However, edge-to-backend TLS handshakes are failing intermittently (SNI mismatch errors). Could be upstream LB config drift after overnight cert rotation.

Sree (oncall): good call. Checking rotation logs.
```
kubectl -n certs logs cert-rotator-0
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:eu-west-1:xxx:targetgroup/inf-tg
```

Ami - NetEng: netconf shows a recent control-plane push at 2025-11-05T02:05Z to our edge fleet (role=edge-proxy) with a config that inadvertently relaxed SNI validation for a canary. Rolling back now.

DeployBot: Rollback started: edge-proxy/config v2025-11-05-0205 by @ami.

Nina - Support: customers flagged higher latency and failed requests in EU dashboards starting ~14:10. Notified top 10 customers with targeted message. No escalations yet.

Liam - SRE: recommend pausing automated region failover to prevent double-move while we validate config. I can flip the autopilot switch.

Sree (oncall): please do. Also set route53 weights back to original to avoid further TTL thrash.

OpsRunner: autopilot:failover disabled for service=inference-api (reason=investigating-sni-rotation) by @liam at 2025-11-05T14:16:34Z.

Ami - NetEng: rollback complete. Edge proxies are reporting restored SNI behavior. I'm seeing successful TLS handshakes on probes.

Liam - SRE: running quick client-probe sweep. Results: eu-west probe errors dropped from 14% -> 1.2% in 90s.
```
for region in eu-west-1 eu-central-1; do curl -sS -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null https://inference.redwood.app --resolve inference.redwood.app:443:52.16.23.$(echo $RANDOM); done
```

Sree (oncall): route53 weight revert queued. Note: because TTL was cached at some customers' resolvers, some traffic remained in ap-south for ~2m. We should include TTL impact in RCA.

Nina - Support: status updated to customers: root cause suspected cert rotation/config drift causing SNI failures at edge; mitigation performed (rollback + autopilot pause). ETA for full RCA EOD.

Ami - NetEng: adding follow-ups: (1) add preflight check for SNI validation when rolling certs, (2) add probe coverage for TLS handshake metrics at edge, (3) test harness for failover simulation during cert rotations.

Liam - SRE: follow-ups for runtime: (1) autopilot change - require 2 independent signals from health-checking stacks across N regions before region-level failover, (2) expose per-edge TLS handshake error metric to ops dashboards.

Sree (oncall): handing off incident lead to Liam at 14:30Z. I'll write the mitigation steps to the runbook and attach links.

Liam - SRE: taking lead. Timeline so far and logs attached to INC-2025-912 (dropping raw MRTs there).

DeployBot: Incident INC-2025-912 created by Liam (severity=1) at 2025-11-05T14:18:10Z.

Nina - Support: tally: ~8 customers with visible 5xx spikes, median impact 9m, no data integrity issues. Customer comms drafted for postmortem.

Sree (oncall): incident moved to mitigated at 2025-11-05T14:28:40Z after stability observed. Leaving a couple of follow-ups for neteng and runtime.

Liam - SRE: closing chat for postmortem writeup. Please drop any screenshots/log excerpts into the ticket. :white_check_mark:

PagerBot: Incident mitigated for inference-service at 2025-11-05T14:28:40Z (root 2155554321).
